admin.title: Administration
admin.denied: There are no administration sections for your role.
admin.copyManual: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.
admin.reason.hint: Recorded in the audit log. No personal data; at least 3 characters.
admin.once.title: Shown only now
admin.once.linkLabel: One-time link to set the password
admin.once.expires: Valid until {when}. Once this window is closed the link cannot be shown again — issue a new one if needed.
admin.once.noPassword: No one ever sees or sends the password. Hand the link to the person securely; they choose their own password.
admin.users.lead: Search and filters run on the server. Every change needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
admin.users.saved.label: Saved filters
admin.users.saved.name: Filter name
admin.users.saved.hint: Only the filter fields are saved, no personal data.
admin.users.empty.hint: Remove a filter or add a new user.
admin.users.note.erased: This account has been anonymised and cannot be changed.
admin.users.note.higher: This account outranks yours and cannot be managed from here.
admin.users.note.self: This is your own account: role, activity, expiry and erasure cannot be changed on yourself; you can issue a password link or export your data.
admin.users.edit.title: Change: {name}
admin.users.edit.signout: Changing role or company, or deactivating the account, immediately signs the person out everywhere.
admin.users.expires.hint: Empty = no expiry. The expiry holds until the end of the chosen day.
admin.users.link.title: New password link: {name}
admin.users.link.text: A one-time link (24 h) will be created. Earlier unused links stop working. The password is never shown.
admin.users.revoke.title: Revoke sessions: {name}
admin.users.revoke.text: The person will be signed out of all devices and will have to sign in again.
admin.users.mfa.title: Reset MFA: {name}
admin.users.mfa.text: The second factor is removed and all sessions end. At the next sign-in the person sets up MFA again (mandatory for staff). Use it when a device is lost.
admin.users.export.title: Export data: {name}
admin.users.export.text: The file contains the person’s personal data (profile, session metadata, what they wrote). The export is recorded in the audit log. Keep the file safe.
admin.users.erase.title: Erase {name}
admin.users.erase.text: Irreversible: name, email and access are anonymised; sessions and links are deleted. The technical content of cases stays under a pseudonymous author. The audit chain is not altered.
admin.users.erase.understand: I understand this cannot be undone
admin.users.erase.mismatch: The email you typed does not match.
admin.users.new.title: New user
admin.users.new.noPassword: No password: after creation you get a one-time link (72 h) with which the person sets their own password.
admin.users.name: Name
admin.users.company.hint: Required for a portal technician (external account).
admin.bulk.title: Bulk action on {count} accounts
admin.bulk.intro: First check how many accounts will be affected, then confirm. Yourself, higher-ranked accounts and erased accounts are skipped.
admin.bulk.willAffect: {affected} of {requested} selected accounts will be affected.
admin.bulk.skipped: Skipped: {count} (yourself, higher rank, erased or already in this state).
admin.products.lead: Models with hardware revisions and firmware range. Control panels, documents and error codes are linked to them.
admin.products.revisions.hint: Each revision has a firmware range start; the end is optional. At least one revision.
admin.products.empty.hint: Start with a model and at least one HW revision.
admin.devices.lead: Physical control panels with serial number and installed firmware. A new QR label invalidates the old one.
admin.devices.company.hint: Empty = own control panel. A new company is created automatically.
admin.devices.options.hint: One entry per line: key=value (e.g. inverter=VF-3).
admin.devices.needProduct: Create a product with an HW revision first.
admin.devices.empty: No control panels match this search.
admin.devices.empty.hint: Register a control panel with serial number and model.
admin.devices.qr.title: QR label for {serial}
admin.devices.qr.first: A QR label will be created. The code is shown only once, for printing.
admin.devices.qr.replace: This control panel already has a label. The new one invalidates the old one immediately: labels already applied stop working. The code is shown only once.
admin.devices.qr.once: The label is visible only now. Print it before closing this window — it cannot be recovered afterwards.
admin.devices.qr.linkNote: The address is the label’s secret: do not share it beyond printing.
admin.docs.lead: Documents enter as drafts and reach the AI only once published. A safety-relevant document is published by a different person.
admin.docs.upload.intro: Choose a PDF (text is extracted on the server after the antivirus scan) or a JSON with text per page. The document is saved as a draft.
admin.docs.file.hint: PDF up to 50 MB or JSON: an array of {page, section, text} or an object with pages and metadata.
admin.docs.file.badJson: The file is not valid JSON with a non-empty list of pages.
admin.docs.upload.done: Document saved as a draft. Text chunks: {chunks}.
admin.docs.warn.title: Pages without text
admin.docs.warn.text: Pages without a text layer (scanned): {pages}. OCR is not performed — these pages will not be searchable.
admin.docs.title: Title
admin.docs.safety.hint: Such a document is published by someone other than the uploader (four-eyes principle).
admin.docs.supersedes.hint: Optional: the revision of the same code that this one withdraws when published.
admin.docs.empty.hint: Upload the first document as a draft.
admin.docs.fourEyes.rule: Safety-relevant document: it is published by someone other than the uploader.
admin.docs.fourEyes.blocked: You uploaded this document and it is safety-relevant. Another knowledge owner must review and publish it — that is the four-eyes principle.
admin.docs.confirm.publish: Once published, {code} ({rev}) becomes available to the AI. Any superseded revision is withdrawn.
admin.docs.confirm.reject: {code} ({rev}) goes back to draft for corrections.
admin.docs.confirm.deprecate: {code} ({rev}) will no longer be available to the AI. No retraining is needed.
admin.docs.review.title: Error codes to review
admin.docs.review.text: The new revision withdrew the old one. {count} error codes that pointed to it are now in review and hidden from the AI until relinked to the new document and published.
admin.docs.pdfReason.invalid: the file is not a readable PDF
admin.codes.lead: Error codes point to a source document. The AI sees only published codes with a published source.
admin.codes.title: Title
admin.codes.source.hint: Pick a published document. Without a published source the code cannot be published.
admin.codes.relations.hint: The action class is also checked by the safety check: steps classed “Safety-relevant” or “Direct command” need a documented procedure.
admin.codes.needSource: A product and at least one published document are required.
admin.codes.empty: No error codes match these filters.
admin.codes.empty.hint: Create a code from a published source document.
admin.codes.reviewNote: This code is in review because its source document was replaced by a new revision. Relink it to the new document and publish it again.
admin.codes.sourceNotPublished: The source document is not published yet: this code cannot be published.
admin.codes.confirm.publish: Once published, {code} (version {version}) becomes available to the AI. A published version with the same scope is withdrawn.
admin.codes.confirm.deprecate: {code} (version {version}) will no longer be available to the AI.
admin.codes.relink.title: Relink {code} to a new document
admin.codes.relink.text: Pick a published document that applies to the model. The code’s checks will point to the new document.
admin.codes.relink.none: No published document applies to this model.
admin.codes.relink.done: Code {code} relinked. Publish it to make it available to the AI.
admin.quick.lead: Templates by role and language. The technician edits them before sending; a published template changes as a new version.
admin.quick.shortcut.hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _; up to 40 characters.
admin.quick.title: Title
admin.quick.body.hint: No personal data — emails, phone numbers and IBANs are masked automatically.
admin.quick.newVersionNote: This template is published or withdrawn: saving creates a new draft version, and the current one stays unchanged until it is published.
admin.quick.created: Quick reply created as a draft.
admin.quick.versioned: A new draft version was created.
admin.quick.confirm.publish: The /{shortcut} ({locale}) version becomes visible to the listed roles; the previously published version is withdrawn.
admin.quick.confirm.deprecate: /{shortcut} ({locale}) will no longer be offered to technicians.
admin.audit.lead: A hash-chained event log: identifiers and codes only, never conversation content. Newest first.
admin.audit.tenantNote: Sign-ins, sign-outs and MFA checks are not shown to the tenant administrator (worker protection); only the platform administrator sees them.

err.invalid_attachment: The file cannot be used here (not scanned, from another case or already attached). Upload it again.
err.pdf_unreadable: The PDF could not be read.
err.unsupported_type: Unsupported file type. Photos: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC; logs: text, CSV, JSON; documents: PDF.
err.duplicate_revision: A document with this code and revision already exists.
err.superseded_not_found: The revision to supersede does not exist for this code.
err.empty_document: The document has no text to index.
err.no_changes: There are no changes to save.
err.file_required: Choose a PDF or JSON file.
att.aiNotice: The photo may be analysed by the AI assistant (Claude, processed in the EU). Do not photograph people or personal data.
att.wait: Wait for the files to finish uploading.
att.failedBlock: A file failed. Retry it or remove it before sending.
att.noPreview: This format cannot be shown here. Download the file.
att.logHint: The log downloads as a file and opens in an app of your choice.
err.link_expired: The file link has expired. Open it again.
err.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired. Try the next code.
err.invalid_token: The link is invalid, already used or expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
err.mfa_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
err.mfa_required_for_role: Two-step verification is mandatory for your role and cannot be turned off. To change device, contact your administrator.
err.mfa_setup_missing: Setup has not started. Start again.
err.edit_window_expired: A message can only be edited within 15 minutes of sending.
err.member_not_allowed: This person cannot be added to the conversation.
err.not_allowed_for_type: This action is not allowed for this kind of conversation.
code.ctx.firmwareOutsideRevision: The firmware is outside the range for this HW revision. Check the version.
code.ingest.pageWithoutText: The page has no text (probably scanned). Add the text by hand.
mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
mfa.error.format: Enter the code using digits only.
mfa.error.invalid: The code is wrong or expired. Wait for the next code and try again.
mfa.setup.title: Turn on two-step verification
mfa.setup.required: It is mandatory for your role. Without it you cannot access cases and conversations.
mfa.setup.intro: You will add an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Aegis). Confirm with your password.
mfa.setup.passwordHint: The password is required so a stolen session cannot enrol someone else’s device.
mfa.setup.step1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.setup.qrAlt: QR code to add to your authenticator app
mfa.setup.manual: Cannot scan? Enter the key by hand:
mfa.setup.openApp: Open in an app on this device
mfa.setup.step2: Enter the code the app shows
mfa.setup.codeHint: Two-step verification turns on only after a correct code.
sec.title: Account and security
sec.mfa.title: Two-step verification
sec.mfa.requiredHint: It is mandatory for your role and cannot be turned off. If you lose the device, an administrator resets it.
sec.mfa.optionalHint: Optional: extra protection for your account.
sec.mfa.disableLabel: App code to turn it off
sec.presence.title: Presence
sec.presence.hint: Presence is for coordination between colleagues only, not for monitoring working hours.
sec.presence.lastSeen: Show colleagues when I was last online
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: The link works once. After saving, sign in with the new password.
reset.rules: At least 12 characters. A long phrase beats a short complicated password.
reset.done: Password changed. All earlier sessions were signed out.
reset.error.token: The link is invalid, already used or expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
reset.error.weak: The password must be at least {min} characters.
reset.error.long: The password is too long (at most {max} characters).
